gaps.title: No single authoritative registry of administrative procedures
gaps.description: Responsibilities between ministries and local councils are not clearly allocated, and there is no single, authoritative, machine-readable source describing each procedure (steps, order, documents, fees, competent authority).
gaps.globalExample: European Union: Single Digital Gateway (Regulation (EU) 2018/1724) and the Points of Single Contact of the Services Directive 2006/123/EC.
